proposed.explanation: Symmetry is not a transformation type. No material is removed. No material is added. Dimensional transformation alters one or more dimensions (height, width, depth) while retaining essential geometric character. A cube stretched tall is still understood as derived from cubic logic—it retains cubic identity but with different proportions. No material is removed (subtractive) or added (additive).
